blurb.zh: 蒙山脚下最穷的猎户家，出了个嘴最贫的孩子。为了一张鹿皮，他越过「勿入」的断碑，捡回一只断了八尾、饿得发慌、连自己名字都想不起来的仙界妖王。她吃了他最后一张饼，许了他一个愿——从此，他的倒霉人生，一路开挂。
blurb.en: The poorest hunter's family under Mount Meng has the mouthiest child. For one deer hide he crosses the stone that says Do Not Enter, and carries home a queen of heaven's foxes — eight tails cut away, starving, unable to recall her own name. She eats his last flatbread and owes him a wish. From then on, his luckless life takes off.

_form: 《鹿鼎记》's form, two lines, the 今 as interludes (纲要 § 一·四, Hanli 2026-10-02: 「两个线不应该并列写，减轻今线的戏份」; 古线 ten 回 → eight in four films of two, 古线卷一改版纲; nine since Hanli 2026-10-07 split 古七 in two: 「可以，拆成两回」). A 卷 opens on 古一; its 古 回 run two by two as films, and after each film a 今 interlude (沈芒, modern science for the 古线's 修仙): 古一 古二 ‖今 · 一‖ 古三 古四 ‖今 · 二‖ 古五 古六 ‖今 · 三‖ 古七 古八 ‖今 · 四‖ 古九 — 今 · 四 sits inside the last film, right before the 卷's last 回, so 卷一 ends on 古九's climax (the 漳水) (Hanli 2026-10-02, after the R3 cold read: both readers said 今 · 四 at the end deflated 漳水 and 赵昂). Only the 古 回 take a 回 number (第一回 … 第九回); an interlude reads 「今 · 一」 ("Now · 1") and takes none. Each entry: `id` (stable forever: h01… 古, j01… 今 — the game's scene `hui`, the 评书 audio and old links name these; never reused), `absorbs` (the ids folded into it — h03 into 古二 h02, h06 into 古四 h05, j02+j03 into 今 · 一 j01, j05+j06 into 今 · 二 j04, j08 into 今 · 三 j07, j10 into 今 · 四 j09: an old ?ch= link or a scene's `hui` naming one opens the entry that holds it), `line` ("gu" | "jin"), `n` (its ordinal WITHIN its line — 古三, 今 · 二 — the 古 file names NN-第N回.md and their title lines carry it: 01-第一回.md … 09-第九回.md, renamed to the 古 ordinal 2026-10-02 (h04 = 03-第三回.md …); 2026-10-07 古七 split: its first half (年二腊月 to 年五, ending on 阿禾's 「亲传，不算外门」) is the new id h11 = 07-第七回.md, its second half (年六 to the 筑基) keeps h09 = 08-第八回.md, and the 漳水 h10 = 09-第九回.md), `huimu` (古: two seven-character lines; 今: one line in 沈芒's own voice), `file`, and `draft: true` only for one Hanli wants held back. An interlude's file is 今线/插曲NN.md, title line 「今 · 一　一句话」; the old 今01–今10 are kept in 今线/旧稿/. The array order IS the book's order: the reader computes 「第N回」 / 「今 · N」 and the tag from it (book-order.js bookEntries), so inserting or moving one is an edit here only. A draft is left out of the published view (and out of its numbering); read.html?draft=1 shows it, numbered in place. DESIGN.md § 五·五.

_aliases: Old chapter ids (序章上 00 … 第二章 03, before the 回), kept so an old read.html?ch= link still opens the 回 that now holds that chapter's start. 2026-09-30 the four 回 were split into ten (OUTLINE § 二·五): old 第三回 (外门) begins 第五回, old 第四回 begins 第九回; ids h03/h04 now name the new 第三回/第四回. 2026-10-02 (卷一 eight 古 回, four 今 interludes): a folded id is no alias but its absorber's `absorbs` (book-order.js resolveId). 2026-10-07 (古七 split): old 第二章 (03) began at the move into the 内门 (腊月初九, the day after the 大比), now the first half of the old h09 — 03 → h11.
_pinyin: Words not read at sight: each carries its pinyin over every character wherever it stands — text, gloss, 回目, table, card (read-md.js pinyinAll; his, 2026-10-07: 只要出现就加拼音). One syllable a character. Of the 八卦 only 巽 and 艮: 坎 坤 震 乾 兑 离 readers know (his, 2026-10-07).
